instructions: Use native host first. Access must be observed in that host, not inferred from public API availability. Effort candidates must be validated by the selected harness. Never switch Claude billing profiles implicitly. OpenCode preferences remain in the existing runner. `selectors` (see families.json) resolve to the newest live ID when the registry is read; `model_ids` are exact.
